integrity_vs_Git: The published mirror verifies exactly 151 regular-file artifact hashes. The raw Git fixture store supplies independent checks of all 48 snapshots and 31 reference packets against the authored protocol operations. Git object directories and the dangling fixture symlink were excluded by the original manifest; these exclusions are disclosed rather than silently treated as hashed files.
limiter_interpretation: Separate profiles corroborate fewer structural calls but substantially more digest/context/witness work. Profile cumulative times overlap and are instrumented; they are not added to timed measurements or treated as causal proof of all elapsed differences.
limits: No benchmark or production/reference code was executed by this auditor; recorded elapsed times cannot be independently reconstructed from outputs.

Work counts for untimed capture/calibration/warmup phases are inferred from the frozen schedule and independently checked per-pack transitions; profiling corroborates one separate actual execution per variant.
The recorded source-before/after snapshots, hashes and historical Git commit bind source identity but cannot prove past execution or timing honesty.
Shared CPython ast and the narrow authored syntax limit semantic independence; this is not a runtime-behavior oracle or an exhaustive cross-product test.
The keep_all transition is a deliberate control with one withheld-supported state per variant; ordinary policy transitions are reported separately.
cProfile is one instrumented post-timing history pack per variant. Cumulative times overlap along call trees; they must not be summed indiscriminately or treated as measured timing samples.
Shared-host variability remains; paired ordering and 21 repetitions do not establish population generalization, significance, or end-to-end corpus savings.
new_only_output: Auditor --out uses exclusive file creation. Control --out requires a new directory and never deletes or overwrites an earlier evidence directory. No sibling bytecode files are generated by the control helper.
profile_attribution: Raw .prof data and all three top20 JSON lists agree exactly. Known frozen research function metadata matches name and definition/decorator line. Stripped filename collisions exist; other dependency entries remain unattributed.
scientific_scope: Independent audit of completed frozen results; no benchmark rerun, CAMI import, original runner/helper/reference import, production source execution, Git network or corpus access.
